title: Financial AI agents keep hallucinating numbers — how do you ground them?
author: RegularSand9001
selftext:
Hey, I’ve been working on AI agents that need reliable financial data (regime detection, earnings, macro indicators, technicals, etc.).Even when I feed them context, they still confidently invent numbers or mix up dates. It’s especially bad with earnings, insider activity, or macro releases.I’ve been experimenting with different ways to reduce this (better prompting, structured context, RAG over primary sources, etc.).For people building similar agents:  
What approaches have worked best for you to stop hallucinations on financial numbers?Curious to hear real experiences.

comments.author: RegularSand9001
comments.body:
I built a small tool that returns structured, timestamped financial context in one call to help with this exact problem.It’s called HelixRead.  
Free tier available here: [https://www.helixread.com](https://www.helixread.com) Happy to share more details or give test keys if anyone wants to try it on their agents.

replies.author: joshman1204
replies.body: Was this meant to come from an alt or did you ask a question just to shill your own shit in a comment?

replies.author: TheKazoobieKazobo
replies.body: You can literally just calculate these indicators yourself and feed them into your agents cycle idk why bro made this.

replies.author: joshman1204
replies.body:
Yeah he thinks he built something but he literally admits he can't even get an agent to stop hallucinating. Didn't we pretty much solve that problem like 6 months ago. I mean yeah it still happens rarely but if it matters your harness should be able to check it.

My agent that deal with real money don't directly interact with a brokerage they interact with a tool that builds the trade and gives the agent a hashed receipt for their report then rust handles the trade with the broker. If the agent hallucinates anything the tool won't give the recipet the shcmea demands.

No service or bullshit needed just reasonable agentic design.

replies.author: TheKazoobieKazobo
replies.body: I made a validation gate. My system is - AI makes trade proposal - trade gets sent to the validation gate, if the entry or exit causes a naked short it denies the trade and it never reaches my broker.
